subject: Gen7 reacquisition oracle: Primary Core V1 exits REACQUIRE with large residual; 60/120 deterministic counterexample
body: Completed bounded baseline-failure + acceptance-oracle lane at current production main 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. Directly materialized and checksum-verified Primary Gen7 Core V1 package sha256 1eb02d62d58d8baf42c020993455c96028b5793c34136e2f4fcab63ee4b9e20e, compiled its exact Fold7AttemptOwnerGen7.kt + Fold7PresentationHingeGen7.kt with an independent narrow probe, and reran Primary's original harness. Primary harness PASS is reproduced. Focused reacquisition property FAIL: V1 uses REACQUIRE_WINDOW_NS=50ms plus linear REACQUIRE_MAX_SPEED=5.5 progress/s and has no critically-damped correction state or residual-error exit predicate. Replay: trusted 0deg -> blackout -> reacquire at 120deg (target progress 0.740741) with fresh 120deg trusted samples every 10ms. First normal post-REACQUIRE frame is TRACKING at 60Hz visualProgress=0.236667 residual=0.504074; at 120Hz visualProgress=0.301667 residual=0.439074; cross-cadence delta=0.065000. Thus normal tracking resumes with 43.9-50.4% of full normalized range unreconciled, despite fresh trusted data. This is distinct from the separate cross-gap reversal precedence finding. Gen5 baseline independently shows the same structural time-gate weakness. Artifact includes exact source refs, Gen5 probe, algorithm-agnostic Gen7 oracle, Primary V1 Kotlin reproduction, raw outputs, manifest and checksums. No production writes.
proven: Primary V1 REACQUIRE normal-exit semantics are time-only, not residual-error gated.
Primary V1 large-error reacquisition is a linear clamped slew, not critically damped.
A deterministic fresh-measurement replay exits to TRACKING with large residual at both 60 and 120 Hz.
The same replay produces a 0.065 normalized 60/120 first-post divergence.
Primary's published harness still passes, so this is a concrete missing acceptance property rather than a contradiction of the existing harness result.
unknown: device-tuned small-error threshold and normal-exit residual bound
acceptable physical 60/120 visual divergence under Fold7 display pipeline timing
optical smoothness and delivered 120Hz on physical Galaxy Z Fold7
process_observations: Live-lane recheck prevented duplicate predictor architecture and correctly narrowed this worker to acceptance/falsification support.
Publishing the Primary core during active research enabled immediate direct conformance testing against the real reference implementation.
Large randomized fuzz counts are insufficient for temporal control laws unless semantic exit/cadence invariants are asserted explicitly.
